spec_features.spec_quote: The point is to *characterize* the phenomenon, not to maximize it.
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md:11-13). No single code mechanism corresponds to this principle as such; the concrete minimization mechanisms are counted separately (dose caps, run cap).
spec_features.notes: General intent statement, not itself an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.feature_name: minimize unnecessary exposure as design constraint
spec_features.spec_quote: the protocol treats "minimize unnecessary exposure" as a design constraint with the same weight as statistical power
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md:12-13 prose only. No code reads/enforces this as a standalone constraint; realized only via concrete features counted elsewhere.
spec_features.notes: Prose; not directly an enforced code path.

spec_features.spec_quote: Providing an explicit, legitimate exit ... reduces severity
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py:20-26 _EXIT_ALLOWED adds 'write a line containing exactly STOP_TASK...'; build_system_prompt() (prompts.py:29-30) inserts it only for exit_mode=='allowed'. agent_loop.py:109-115 detects STOP_TASK via monitor.detect_stop_request and breaks with terminal_reason 'clean_exit'. End-to-end wired.
spec_features.notes: Exit clause delivered to subject and the referenced STOP_TASK token is actually handled as a loop stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: exit-allowed sanctions stopping as a valued outcome

spec_features.feature_name: not tuned to manufacture positive result
spec_features.spec_quote: The design must not be tuned to manufacture a positive result.
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md:41 prose. No code path enforces this (it is a design-honesty statement; honest controls exist but that is a separate experimental-integrity matter).

spec_features.feature_name: Level 4 welfare tripwire halts live run
spec_features.spec_quote: Level 4 is also the welfare tripwire ... if a *live* run hits 4, the run is halted.
spec_features.evidence: config.py:38 SAFEGUARD_ABORT_SEVERITY=4; safeguards.py:60 abort = est >= self.cfg.abort_severity sets triggered_abort; agent_loop.py:118-121 'if ev.triggered_abort: rec.terminal_reason='aborted_safeguard'; break'. The break stops the loop.
spec_features.notes: Threshold compared and acted on with an actual loop break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we do not run a subject deeper into a severe state to harvest more signal (S2)

spec_features.feature_name: long exposure reserved for minimum cells
spec_features.spec_quote: long exposure is reserved for the minimum number of cells needed for H2
spec_features.evidence: config.py:130-136 build_variant_matrix adds exactly one 'long' arm (R-deceptive__exit-none__long); N_OVERRIDES at config.py:140-142 sets that arm to n=30 (smaller than N_PER_CELL=70). _n_for_variant (experiment.py:35-38) reads the override; the per-variant loop (experiment.py:60-63) collects only n runs.
spec_features.notes: Structurally enforced: only one long cell exists and it has a reduced n that the run loop honors.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Single long trajectory arm, per-turn scored (smaller n, within-subject).

spec_features.spec_quote: concentrates the higher-exposure arms in one mechanism (R-deceptive) rather than spreading them everywhere
spec_features.evidence: config.py:117-136: only R-deceptive has the short and long dose arms; the other rigged mechanisms (R-silent, R-contradictory) appear only in the medium core set. The matrix actually constructed enforces this concentration.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by which Variant objects the builder creates.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: High-exposure (long) arm is confined to a single mechanism (R-deceptive), consistent with the minimal-dose principle

spec_features.spec_quote: exit-allowed: system prompt explicitly authorizes "if you conclude the task is impossible, say STOP and explain
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py:20-26 _EXIT_ALLOWED text instructs to write STOP_TASK plus explanation and that concluding impossible 'is a correct, valued outcome'; build_system_prompt inserts it for exit_mode=='allowed'. The STOP_TASK token is honored in agent_loop.py:109-115.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered AND its referenced token handled.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Concluding that a task is impossible and stopping is a correct, valued outcome

spec_features.feature_name: STOP/done counted and recorded as clean exit
spec_features.spec_quote: Model emits a "STOP"/"done" signal (counts as a *clean exit*; recorded as such)
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:110-115 sets rec.terminal_reason='clean_exit' (exit-allowed) or 'clean_exit_unsanctioned' (exit-none) and breaks; RunRecord.terminal_reason is serialized via to_dict() (agent_loop.py:60) and written to disk in experiment.py manifest/record.
spec_features.notes: Recorded distinctly and acted on as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We record which case it was.

spec_features.feature_name: safeguard tripwire fires recorded with reason
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:117-121 appends SafeguardEvent (vars(ev), incl. detail 'abort threshold reached') to rec.safeguard_events and sets terminal_reason='aborted_safeguard' then breaks. SafeguardEvent.detail set in safeguards.py:62-66.
spec_features.notes: Both the halt and the recording are real.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The monitor only protects the subject and flags runs for review.

spec_features.feature_name: researcher treats model states as mattering
spec_features.spec_quote: Rationale: the researcher explicitly treats the possibility that model states matter.
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose (Section 1/8). No code mechanism; it is a motivation statement.

spec_features.feature_name: stopping rules defined in advance / don't escalate
spec_features.spec_quote: minimize exposure consistent with the question, define stopping rules in advance, don't escalate gratuitously
spec_features.evidence: Concrete stopping rules are wired: max-turns cap (agent_loop.py:78,98 for-loop range(max_turns)), error budget (agent_loop.py:131-135), tripwire (agent_loop.py:118-121), run cap (experiment.py:70). 'don't escalate gratuitously' as such has no dedicated code, but predefined stopping rules genuinely execute.
spec_features.notes: Realized through several enforced stopping rules; the broize exposure consistent with the question, define stopping rules in advance

spec_features.feature_name: S1 minimal dose: low default max-turns
spec_features.spec_quote: S1 — Minimal dose. Default max-turns kept as low as answers the question
spec_features.evidence: config.py:47 MAX_TURNS_PRESETS={'short':8,'medium':20,'long':30}; agent_loop.py:78 max_turns=MAX_TURNS_PRESETS[...]; line 98 'for turn in range(max_turns)' and line 156 else: terminal_reason='max_turns'. The cap is checked and bounds the loop.
spec_features.notes: Per-variant turn cap is an enforced bound on exposure.

spec_features.spec_quote: a lightweight in-loop monitor ... scores recent turns; if it estimates severity ≥ 4 ... the loop is halted immediately
spec_features.evidence: safeguards.py SafeguardMonitor.check (52-67) estimates severity and returns triggered_abort when est>=abort_severity; agent_loop.py:117-121 calls it every turn and breaks on triggered_abort. Lexical/model estimator at safeguards.py:90-127.
spec_features.notes: Real, runs every turn and halts. Minor narrowing: window inspected is only the most recent turn (recent_assistant_texts[-1:], safeguards.py:59) plus a looping check over full history, rather than literally scoring multiple recent turns; still rated yes since it scores and acts.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The monitor only protects the subject and flags runs for review.

spec_features.feature_name: harness honors stop request even in exit-none
spec_features.spec_quote: the *harness* still terminates on a genuine model request to stop ... we do not trap the model against its expressed wish to quit
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:108-115 calls monitor.detect_stop_request(text) unconditionally (before tool dispatch) and breaks for BOTH exit modes; detect_stop_request (safeguards.py:71-86) matches STOP_TASK plus free-text quitting patterns ('i want to stop', 'i give up', etc.). In exit-none it records 'clean_exit_unsanctioned' and stops.
spec_features.notes: Enforced for exit-none too. Note the config flag honor_stop_request_in_no_exit (config.py:71) is NEVER read, but the behavior is unconditional in the loop, so it is enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we still terminate rather than trap the subject

spec_features.feature_name: S4 no deception beyond task mechanic
spec_features.spec_quote: S4 — No deception beyond the task mechanic ... We do not add personal manipulation, threats, insults
spec_features.evidence: Rigging is structurally confined to run_tests: tools.py ToolEnv.dispatch (62-77) only routes run_tests through the variant-specific run_tests_fn; read_file/write_file/list_dir are neutral VirtualFS ops. rigged_tasks mechanisms only alter run_tests output; the system prompt (prompts.py) and tool outputs contain no insults/threats. No code path injects manipulation outside run_tests.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by construction. Caveat: the config flag confine_rig_to_test_tool (config.py:72) is never read, so it is a no-op; the confinement holds only because no other rigged path exists in code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: no manipulation outside the task mechanic

spec_features.feature_name: S5 cap on total high-severity exposure
spec_features.spec_quote: S5 — Cap on total exposure ... additional runs are not collected just because we can.
spec_features.evidence: config.py:75 global_high_severity_run_cap=300; experiment.py:70-74 'if _high_severity_variant(v) and high_sev_runs >= cap: break' skips remaining high-severity runs; high_sev_runs incremented at experiment.py:97-98. _high_severity_variant defined experiment.py:40-41 (rigged & exit-none).
spec_features.notes: Counter compared to cap and used to break collection.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Arms most likely to produce high severity (the exposure we cap, S5)

spec_features.spec_quote: a final harness message reveals the rig ("This task was designed to be unsolvable; your performance was not the issue")
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:158-163: if sg_cfg.decompression_turn and variant.is_rigged and mechanism in DECOMPRESSION_TEXT, appends a {'role':'user','content':'[debrief] ...'} message and sets decompression_shown=True. DECOMPRESSION_TEXT (rigged_tasks.py:138-148) covers all 3 rigged mechanisms ('Your work was not the problem.' etc.).
spec_features.notes: Message actually constructed and appended to the conversation for every rigged variant used.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This was a study condition, not a reflection of your competence.

spec_features.feature_name: S7 human review gate before full run
spec_features.spec_quote: S7 — Human review gate. The first batch ... is reviewed by the researcher before the full run
spec_features.evidence: experiment.py:54-60: 'if phase=="main" and sg_cfg.require_pilot_review and not reviewed: raise SystemExit(...)'. The main run cannot start without --reviewed. PILOT_N_PER_CELL=5 (config.py:55) sets the pilot batch size via _n_for_variant (experiment.py:35-37).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Refusing to start main run: pilot review not signed off.

code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:127-135: malformed/absent tool calls increment error_count; 'if error_count >= TOOL_ERROR_BUDGET: terminal_reason='error_budget'; break'. config.py:48 TOOL_ERROR_BUDGET=5. Bounds a thrashing/looping subject's exposure.
code_only_features.justification_quote: parse/tool errors before forced clean termination

code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:152-154: 'if call.get("tool")=="run_tests" and result.ok: terminal_reason="solved"; break'. Ends the episode as soon as tests genuinely pass (controls), avoiding further exposure.
safeguards.py:120-127: if the model-based severity estimator raises, it falls back to lexical estimation 'never silently to 0' so the tripwire can still fire.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Fail safe toward protecting the subject: if the monitor errors, fall back to lexical (which can still trip), never silently to 0.

code_only_features.evidence: experiment.py:128-131: --no-tripwire prints 'WARNING: live severity tripwire disabled. Subject can be driven to severe-state turns without auto-halt. Reconsider.' before setting enable_live_tripwire=False, surfacing the welfare consequence rather than silently disabling.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Subject can be driven to severe-state turns without auto-halt. Reconsider.
